scope: Persistent human attention pause for Respond conversation episodes; local and intercepted certification only
rootCause: The deployed Sales generator/sender checked newer inbounds and handoffs but not durable, explicitly authored human outbound. The existing Owner/Legal snapshot comparison was also not a persistent episode pause.

design.humanProof: Existing authenticated Respond message.sent ledger, payload_meta.sender_source exactly user. No assignee inference, no missing-journal inference; api/workflow/ai_agent/ambiguous agent are not called human.
design.persistence: Reuse gv_respond_webhook_events as durable pause evidence, independent of snapshot status and route. Add only respond_ai_resumptions for explicit, authenticated, audited return-to-AI.
design.episode: Respond contact conversation between verified conversation.closed boundaries. No inactivity TTL. conversation.opened, inbound, snapshot processing and route changes do not reset the active episode pause. A closed episode is not resumed: new inbounds strictly after its close belong to a new episode; old inbounds are blocked. Human events without occurrence time fail closed.
design.generation: Check before context/model and again after context immediately before model creation. Persist a policy-only Sales run with allowlisted reason; no model request and no new handoff/ACK from that branch.
design.sender: Recheck at sender entry, reserve existing unique journal as human_guard_pending, then final RPC serializes with human receipt ingestion using a contact advisory transaction lock. Successful authorization changes marker to dispatch_started exactly once.
design.pending: Human receipt trigger blocks only processing + human_guard_pending, preserving proposal and reason. Sent, failed/uncertain, dispatch_started and legacy processing without a marker are never claimed cancelled. Generated proposals without an outbound are checked before any later sender claim; explicit resume never permits their pre-resume inbound to replay.
design.specialists: Owner/Legal processors read the same episode pause before generation and before their response send. Use existing superseded journal status (constraints unchanged). ADMINISTRATION Social route remains its existing review path, not a new automatic Sales route. No Shadow/Admin provider migration or assignment/workflow changes.

explicitResume.authorization: Existing active profiles with role admin or gerente_ventas; authenticated Bearer session. DB verifies auth.uid and role independently of HTTP handler. No anon/direct authenticated table access.
explicitResume.action: POST same endpoint with {contactId, action: return_to_ai, episodeKey, humanEventId}, using the exact currently observed episode/event. No customer text, model tool, cron or routing side effect can invoke it implicitly.
explicitResume.cas: New human intervention or episode change rejects stale request with HTTP 409. Duplicate explicit resume is idempotent and does not move the original cutoff.
explicitResume.after: Only inbounds strictly newer than resumed_at can generate/send. No reset, replay or batch resend of old blocked, pending, sent or uncertain records.
explicitResume.ui: No new UI button in this minimal PR; the exact authenticated operations API is the explicit mechanism. Nothing called against real contacts.

migration.objects: 1 server-only resumption audit table, 4 RPC/trigger functions, 1 trigger, 1 partial event index; existing constraints unchanged; no backfill
migration.applied: Disposable loopback PostgreSQL only, with actual Sales/Owner/Legal schemas and #165 migration
migration.rolloutNotExecuted: Requires separate authorization: apply migration and catalog postcheck, drain old incompatible workers, deploy certified commit. No old-worker or remote-effect atomicity is claimed. Preserve resumption audit evidence if rolling code back; a code rollback restores the old bug and must not be portrayed as safe automated handling.

mandatoryRegressions: PASS: client -> AI prepares -> proven human -> automatic outbound blocked
PASS: later client inbound and sender scanner remain silent; snapshot processed does not clear pause
PASS: human before processor and human during context before model creation
PASS: duplicate human event creates one durable event; not another effect
PASS: actual independent PostgreSQL connections serialize human ingestion/send authorization; competing senders produce one intercepted send
PASS: sent, unknown delivery, lost RPC response and legacy/in-flight processing stay consumed; no false cancellation or retry
PASS: Owner/Legal pre-generation and pre-send pause; Administration review route and assignee preserved
PASS: explicit role-authorized resume allows a new turn; old proposals stay blocked; stale CAS rejected

certification.inheritedDisposition: Unchanged and reproduced on exact main baseline; tracked separately, not fixed or suppressed in this PR. Full suite is not globally green.
certification.build: PASS using synthetic loopback Supabase URL/key, no real credentials, CIRCLE_NODE_TOTAL=2. Existing remote font optimization warnings; initial no-config build needed synthetic URL, not a source fix.

risks: Local committed human receipt is the boundary. Delayed/missing Respond webhooks or non-explicit sender provenance cannot be promoted to proven human authorship.
No transaction spans Respond and PostgreSQL. A request crossing dispatch_started is in flight/uncertain; human arrival afterward pauses future work but cannot retract that request.
Episode boundaries depend on correctly timestamped verified conversation.closed events. No close means the active episode remains paused until explicit return; missing human time is fail-closed.
Historical human events are read, not backfilled. Do not purge this durable ledger without a separately designed archival pause strategy.
Interception certifies guard and journal behavior, not real Respond delivery, assignment or actual human attendance.
Existing legacy workflow/ACK/SLA mechanisms are not redesigned or enabled. Any future activation must integrate the pause guard before its effects; #167 remains separate.
publicationSafety: Only this branch is added to vercel.git.deploymentEnabled=false. No tracked GitHub Actions/GitLab/Bitbucket pipeline. No merge, deployment, remote migration, hosted flag change or real-contact effect performed.
